notes.title: Hey people! Another update for you, featuring

items.text: Updates for two chase cutscenes
We hope we've finally fixed the fall-through-the-ground bug, but we're never sure about this one
Minor update for ammo bag
Mouse sensitivity slider in Settings got fixed so it's always seen
Hopefully, we've fixed the crash when you launch the game for the first time

Some other minor bugfixes: Enjoy the game! Fear the spooks! Have a great Halloween!
First things first - Spooktober update is live and ready to be downloaded. It features:
Updates to 2 of 3 endings
Updates to Lamp, Oiler, and Shovel models
In-game achievements menu
Main menu UI sounds a bit different and more PSX'y
Small rain update, which makes it way less heavy for your PC;
We fixed some bugs in the stealth section which was very hard to complete without a gun
Added translations to Italian, Polish and Hungarian, thanks to Luca Cassinelli, Krzysztof Gmyr, and Brechler "lostprophet" Zsolt
Main menu now features links to out Twitter and Discord server, where you can read all the news. Wait, what?
Is opened. A place where you can ask us anything, send memes, artwork, communicate and read news about our games and development process.

Also, we've announced a new game today - Hollowsk 1999 3D. It's a horror adventure game set in post-soviet city drowned in a nightmare. Check it out, be sure to wishlist and follow it to receive news.

notes.title: I've also bought a cool domain for it soviethill.com :smile

items.text: Would like to hear your opinions on the endings, as one of them I think may be one of the best things I've done in terms of horror.

releases.displayName: Director's Cut update and OST released

items.text: Free update is available to download for all game owners. The features list is below. If you want to support us please consider purchasing freshly released OST. Also please leave a review for the game if you didn't yet - that helps a lot, that's basically our most efficient marketing tool as our marketing budget is $0.
Mac and Linux versions
Controller support
New settings (mouse inversion, key mapping, mouse sensitivity)
Level selection from the menu
Almost half of the game (second half, to be clear) is remade, including all of the endings;
Some of the first half of the game scenes are updated too;
2 challenging (but not too challenging, I guess) boss fights;
Some of the game's scenes that frustrate people more than the others are now skippable
Changed more than half of achievements. Sadly, that means you've lost their old versions
Storyline is updated to express the original ideas;
More seagulls;

As it was promised a year ago, sandbags are now 3D model: Maybe we'll also add stuff like Steam Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges, and Profile Backgrounds soon, but I'm not sure and can't promise that.: We love you ːisaacː: Have fun and leave your feedback here.: P.S. Old version of the game will be available as Beta in few days, I'll post the instruction on how to play it.

items.text: Many people haven't heard anything from us in a while - I'm sorry, developing the update took much longer than I expected.
The Isolated Year Update - that we've decided to call Director's cut for simplicity and marketing purpose (everyone knows what Director's cut is) - is coming out tomorrow, 12.09.2021.

I'll publish a full list of updated things tomorrow, but right now I may give you a shorter one: half of the game remade, achievements changed, endings changed (maybe it will be a disappointing change for someone), the storyline makes more sense and closer to the original idea even though you may not think so from the first time you play, 2 BOSSFIGHTS in a walking sim with actual challenging gameplay holy crap; better settings, level selection (no new game for achievement farming), controller support, Mac and Linux versions, a sexy intro with our company logo and an OST release.
Everything is for free (well, not OST) and included as a part of the base game, as I hate DLC's. Though if you want to support us you may purchase the OST, it also releases tomorrow.
Oh yeah, if you liked the old labyrinth level it's your last day to enjoy it.

P.S. I'm sorry for folks who lost their achievements without any warning from our side - I was sure the achievement update is not public yet, as I haven't pressed "Publish" button for it in Steam developer dashboard.
Also, I'm sorry for many questions being unanswered in discussions. I always thought I should get a notification if there are new discussions, and thought there are none - obviously, I was wrong.
Follow us on Twitter if you want to see more unexpected name changes for free updates https://twitter.com/sowokegames
